content: The dictionaries are often manually compiled, but increasingly they are constructed semi-automatically (e.g., BIBREF40 ). When we semi-automatically create a word list, we use automation to identify an initial word list, and human insight to filter it. By automatically generating the initial words lists, words can be identified that human annotators might have difficulty intuiting. By manually filtering the lists, we use our theoretical understanding of the target concept to remove spurious features.
